Would You Rather: Superhero Outfit Tower 🦸‍♂️🦸‍♀️

Get ready to scale the ultimate high-tech superhero high-rise! On every single floor, you'll face an impossible "Would You Rather" heroic style dilemma. Do you vibe more with armored nano-tech suits and capes 🦸‍♂️ or sleek tactical jackets and combat boots 🥾? Make your pick and see how the rest of the players voted!

Choose carefully, because every answer unlocks a legendary hero upgrade:
✨ Glowing energy halos, custom emblem chestplates, and sleek hero masks!
💀 OR a rusty, mismatched item that will totally RUIN your superhero aesthetic!

Can you survive the villainous climb and reach the top with a flawless 10/10 hero look? 💅

💖 Hit that LIKE button and JOIN THE GROUP for exclusive super-powered bonuses!
